Delivery Methods:
Free Standard Delivery — Mattresses ship compressed via USPS® or UPS® ground shipping partners. Delivery timelines are estimated once your order is produced, and specific delivery dates cannot be scheduled with this method.
Doorstep/Curbside Delivery — For items over 150 lbs, we use doorstep delivery through our partners SEKO and BTX. This service starts at $99 for the first large item, with a maximum charge of $198 per order.
In-Home Delivery & Setup — An optional upgraded service that includes scheduled delivery, assembly, and setup.
Important Notes:
We ship within the Continental United States, Alaska, and Hawaii.

How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Seen • Just now
Standard shipping timing breaks down into two phases:
Production Time:
Most orders are processed and shipped within 1-5 business days, excluding holidays and weekends.
Mattress production typically takes about 3-5 business days, though more complex mattresses can take up to 3 weeks.
Specific products may have different timelines — for example, Grand Luxe Mattresses typically ship within 3-4 weeks of order placement.
Transit Time:
Once shipped, ground deliveries with USPS or UPS can take anywhere from 2-5 business days to arrive.
In-home delivery and doorstep items (like furniture and flat-packed or very heavy mattresses) can take 1-3 weeks to arrive at a local delivery hub before the team schedules delivery dates.
Keep in mind that "business days" don't include weekends or holidays. Delivery timelines are estimated by shippers once your order is produced, and production timing may vary from original estimates.
If you need help tracking your existing order or have questions about its status, I'd be happy to connect you with our team who can look up the specific details!
